About

A writer and director focused on creating grotesque American folklore. His pitch black comedy underlines tales of depravity, aimed at inciting self reflection from the viewer.


Todor Pophristic seeks to bastardize the beautiful and empathize with the ugly in his unique brand of nihilism.
